meta.scope: Validation log and evidence-matrix registration for four newly published GitHub code entities

records.title: Emulation of the Drosophila Fly Brain
FlyGym: Simulating embodied sensorimotor control with NeuroMechFly v2
FLYBOX: an open-source connectome sandbox for a simulated fruit-fly nervous system

claims.claim: The repository provides multiple implementations of an adult Drosophila connectome-derived LIF model and benchmark tooling.
claims.limitation: Code and benchmark artifacts were inspected but not independently executed; no nociception, pain, ECAP or human-transfer validation.
claims.permitted_conclusion: Use as a candidate simulation backend and reproducibility target only.

decisions.notes: Primary repository metadata and README verified; independent execution pending.

claims.claim: The repository provides a dense/sparse snnTorch port with synthetic sensory stimulation examples.
claims.limitation: Charts and runtime were not independently reproduced; sensory encoders are engineering inputs rather than validated natural transduction.
claims.permitted_conclusion: Use as a candidate SNN implementation baseline only.

decisions.notes: Primary repository metadata and README verified; independent execution pending.

claims.claim: The official FlyGym repository provides the NeuroMechFly v2 embodied sensorimotor simulation framework.
claims.evidence: Official repository README at commit 38c8ec61034cd59bc5ba0de20688d4a3c0000d60 and release v2.1.0
claims.limitation: Framework has no built-in pain, nociception, ECAP or SCS target and was not executed in this review.
claims.permitted_conclusion: Use as an embodied simulation substrate, separately from biological pain claims.

decisions.notes: Official code entity linked to publication record S731.

claims.claim: FLYBOX provides an open interactive sandbox around a FlyBrain/MaleCNS simulation with explicit experimental encoders and decoders.
claims.limitation: Repository explicitly disclaims complete biological simulation and natural behavior; runtime was not independently reproduced.
claims.permitted_conclusion: Use as an experimental sandbox candidate, not biological validation.

decisions.notes: Primary repository metadata and README verified; independent execution pending.
